notes.title: On Your Tail Patch 1.1.4 is LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
So it took a bit of time. And some rollbacks. But hopefully this is it, this is the massive 1.1.4 On Your Tail patch that brings lots of bug fixes, performance improvements and small and big changes.
Apologies for the delay, It took a bit longer than expected: the game is huge and there are a tons of interconnected systems, properly testing it requires a massive amount of time!

This patch introduces a massive amount of improvements and fixes and 100% aligns the PC version with the Switch version (Switch patch 1.1.4 is currently in Nintendo lotcheck and we hope to deploy it soon).
Aside from good performance improvements, you should see greater stability across the board and a lot of fixes to potential blockers and sotftlocks.

Again thank your your patience, our goal is to keep working on the game to improve it as much as possible and offer you an amazing experience.

The Memorable Games Team

notes.title: On Your Tail giga update 1.1.1 is now live
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that the new On Your Tail update is L I V E  N O W, and it's a massive one! We've been working hard for the last two months and ahead of the Nintendo Switch release to improve the game as much as possible following feedbacks from our fantastic community.
We've published a roadmap earlier this year, and...

https://steamcommunity.com/games/2132560/announcements/detail/535464867257122842

...we're happy to announce that almost everything in there has been implemented in this update! Withoutr further ado let's dive in and give you some more details!

Gameplay camera improvements
We got some negative feedbacks on the in game camera, and we really didn't see them coming since during development and extensive playtesting no one actually reported it. We take feedbacks extremely seriously and so we worked hard to overhaul the in game camera and give our players a lot of customization options to better suit everyones' needs. In fact, we impleented a full new Camera menu!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/ed3c5eee74e7286844703f2d9b89a703ed82c5da.png

The new options:
- There are now three different camera presets, both for interior and exterior cameras: Standard, Comfonrt and Cinematic. Youi can change cameras in the menu or change them in real time by pressing H (Keyboard) or L1 / LB.
- Camera control acceleration
- Camera damping both on movement and on rotation
- Full FoV and camera distance from the player control: this is extremely useful if you're playing on an ultrawide screen!
- We've also fine tuned the mouse sensitivity slider.

The game now starts with better presets that should mitigate potential motion sickness problems.

❤️❤️Love everyone update❤️❤️
As promised on Valentine's Day, you can now romance and kiss all the four love interest in the game. You don't have to choose: you can kiss everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/c60f8c475e1383dc9706b388684e0e806d4ab275.png
Smooooooooooch!

Improved performances - engine update to Unity 6
In preparation for the Switch release, we did a ton of work on the under the hood to optimize the game. First of all, we updated the engine to Unity 6. This will help us down the line to optimize the game even further and to push visual fidelity higher. Aside from other massive optimizations, we're reworked our world streaming system to minimize performances problem while loading different areas of Borgo Marina: on Steam Deck you should get higher frame rates across the board and almost zero stuttering.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/934042d51cd3a1f4cb24167e62f54a4bf30677a8.png

Improved translations and extra dialogues
We improved some sub par translations, specifically we completely reworked the [spoiler]Chea's riddles[/spoiler] translations. We've also added some new dialogue lines to better explain some part of the story.

Gameplay tweaks and balancing
Lots of improvements big and small to make your stay in Borgo Marina even more pleasant:
- More Jocker Cards during the investigations: you can get more cards, but also use more to solve the puzzles if you're stuck.
- Increased the number of fishing zones and more money from fishing and harvesting ingredients.
- Fishing tweaks to make the mini game easier.
- Improved cooking: we've made the minigame easier and changed some difficult inputs
- You can now quit some previously un-quittable mini games!
- Mind Palace improvements: added icons to better show when an activity has been completed (stargazing, cooking, movie watcing etc...).
- Added the ability to open the quest log in the map screen.

There are a lot more smaller tweaks that will improve your experience with the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/676bacaf7210a606c7d5e8f7d1402b4c72e43bb2.png
It's now easier to get those pesky onions...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/610b2edb31474d1ee64441540ca18a9f1285ad85.png
You can look at the quest log with the map open: how convenient!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/13ea2da2b899ad58c0a4aff763940a03f6c8ab71.png
New icons added to better keep track of your progress!

Added visual details and tweaks
We've added some small visual tweaks and detail to make your stay in Borgo Marina even more unforgettable: a rotating lighthouse beam during the night, to fully animated clocktower hands (bells are next!) to much improved water rendering...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/265e4f48456bf609a5d407febe86050433b6d112.png
Tick tock, tick tock!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/1339ff0ee496ce4f336e99b035cce30515cdfd92.png
More watery water and more wavy waves...

What's missing...
We still have to implement full key remapping. It's something we'll definitely do but it still requires a bit of work! Apologies for this, we'll keep you up to date.

🪳🪳Oh, almost forgot! We also fixed bugs! Lots of bugs!🪳🪳

We really hope you'll enjoy this update and that you'll all have an even better experience in Borgo Marina! We have more updates coming!

Thank you for your support!
The Memorable Games Team

notes.title: Is it possible to patch an Art Book? Yes...
notes.notes:
So, this is awkward: we've just patched the On Your Tail Artbook.
Is it possible? Yes.
Is it weird? Oh yes.

Basically, some dates were plain wrong in the initial release of the artbook, making it impossible for the players to deduce a correct timeline. Ages of some characters were wrong too.

And now it's fixed! Everything makes sense now!

The Memorable Games Team

notes.title: On Your Tail Patch 1.0.4 is live now with lots of improvements!
notes.notes:
Hey there!
As anticipated, the team is hard at work in fixing and improving the game as much as possible, and we have an hefty patch ready for you today, full of fixes and QoL improvements!

Bug fixes

 Fixed the 'fall though the world' bug when walking around Borgo Marina
 Fixed a lot of translations errors in various languages
 Fixed some conditions preventing to end the [spoiler]"Bambina Scomparsa"[/spoiler] mystery.
 Fixed some missing Achievements
 Added some missing cards to the Mind Palace
 Fixed the Camera clipping plane (it was too near)
 Fixed the button to remove the UI with the Camera equipped
 Fixed the ability to properly reset some settings both in game and in the main menu
 Fixed a potential soft lock at dinner time [spoiler]after going out to see the falling star with a friend[/spoiler]
 Fixed some issues in the Mind Palace
 Removed the D-PAD on screen glyph when the player has no tools
 Fixed an issue while leaving the Ice Cream shop with an ice cream flavour
 Fixed the romance with [spoiler]Peina[/spoiler]. If done as the first romance tha player was given no choice and had to kiss her, preventing future romances.
 Fixed a cheat with the piggy bank
 Fixed a bug preventing the player to get the Level 2 fishing rod. If you get the fishing rod Level 3 first, Level 2 unlocks automatically. If you're already unlocked the Level 3 fishing rod, just talk to Chea to get the Lefel 2 fishing rod.
 Lots of other small bug fixes.


Quality of life improvements
We've added some 'soft' fast travel options during the story! While it's not a full fast travel implementation, this will require more time, those fast travel point should help while playing the story:


 After [spoiler]solving the Villa di Orlando Theft mystety[/spoiler] at Chea you can back to the Villa immediately.
 After [spoiler]finding the Fidato's villa gate closed[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to Chea immediately.
 After [spoiler]ending the Mystery at Forte Esterin[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to the Docks
 After [spoiler]finding the Lexua's boat and the fallen tunnel[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to Villa De Montoni
 After [spoiler]ending the Lexua's interrogation you can fast travel back to Villa Fidato[/spoiler]
 After [spoiler]taking the final picture of Borgo Marina for Paun[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to the Foto e Foto shop


Ultrawide support
We're striving to offer full ultrawide support in the future, but it still needs a lot of improvements. In this build, we've unlocked all the resolution options, so you should be able to play the game with your native screen resolution. You may have some visual glitches, but it's a first step!

Thanks for all your support and for staying in touch with us and reporting bugs! The game is big but we're trying our best to fix as many as possible in the shortest timeframe possible and to improve the game following your suggestions.

The Memorable Games team

notes.title: We're working on bug fixes and improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a warm thank you from the Memorable Games team for all your support, we really hope you're enjoying the game!

We've been monitoring closely the Steam forum and our Discord and social channel and we're working non stop to fix the reported bugs and on implementing much needed quality of life improvements to the game.
We really hoped to have the game bug free from day one and we did extensive both internal and external QA and playtesting, but the game is big and some bugs are really difficult to reproduce.

We'll deploy a first patch today addressing most of the bugs, we'll give you a full list of bug fixes and changes, and we'll have at least one more by the end of the week.
Some Quality of Life improvements will be implemented this week, others will require a bit more time.

In the meantime, please keep sending us bug reports, suggestions and feedbacks.

Aside from Steam, you can also join our Discord community and get in touch with us directly here:
- On Your Tail Discord Community

Thanks for your patience!
Memorable Games
